note: Cowen & Keltner (2017) 27 distinct emotion categories with fuzzy gradient bridges. Per specification Section 2, 'romance' and 'sexual desire' are presented cleanly with 'Attraction' as their unified category header.

categories.label: Admiration
categories.definition: Warm respect and approval toward someone's exceptional skill, courage, or generosity.
categories.exampleScene: Watching a mentor calmly solve a crisis while giving credit to the junior team.

categories.label: Adoration
categories.definition: Deep, tender affection and devotion toward someone cherished.
categories.exampleScene: A parent watching their sleeping child or greeting a long-missed partner at the station.

categories.label: Aesthetic Appreciation
categories.definition: Being absorbed and moved by beauty in art, architecture, music, or landscapes.
categories.exampleScene: Standing quietly before a sunlit canyon or listening to a cello solo.

categories.label: Amusement
categories.definition: Lighthearted playfulness triggered by humor, wit, or harmless incongruity.
categories.exampleScene: Sharing an unexpected inside joke with a friend during a quiet meeting.

categories.label: Anger
categories.definition: Energized mobilization against perceived unfairness, boundary violation, or obstruction.
categories.exampleScene: Discovering someone took credit for a colleague's months of work.

categories.label: Anxiety
categories.definition: Restless, future-oriented vigilance scanning for uncertain risks or failure.
categories.exampleScene: Waiting in the hallway before receiving important medical or career results.

categories.label: Awe
categories.definition: Wonder in the presence of something vast that challenges one's accustomed frame of reference.
categories.exampleScene: Watching a total solar eclipse plunge the horizon into twilight.

categories.label: Awkwardness
categories.definition: Self-conscious social friction when conversational timing or norms misfire.
categories.exampleScene: Waving back enthusiastically at someone who was actually waving to the person behind you.

categories.label: Boredom
categories.definition: Restless fatigue and disengagement when an environment offers neither challenge nor meaning.
categories.exampleScene: Sitting through a monotonous two-hour reading of boilerplate policy slides.

categories.label: Calmness
categories.definition: Settled physiological peace, clear attention, and freedom from urgency.
categories.exampleScene: Drinking morning tea on a quiet porch while rain falls outside.

categories.label: Confusion
categories.definition: Mental friction when new evidence contradicts expectations and calls for reanalysis.
categories.exampleScene: Reading assembly instructions that reference parts that do not exist in the box.

categories.label: Craving
categories.definition: Focused physiological or motivational urge toward a specific desired reward.
categories.exampleScene: Smelling fresh-baked bread after hiking all afternoon in the cold.

categories.label: Disgust
categories.definition: Visceral rejection of contamination, spoilage, or severe ethical violation.
categories.exampleScene: Opening a forgotten container in the back of the refrigerator.

categories.label: Empathetic Pain
categories.definition: Immediate visceral wince and shared distress when witnessing someone else get hurt.
categories.exampleScene: Seeing a runner twist their ankle badly on the curb right in front of you.

categories.label: Entrancement
categories.definition: Deep, effortless absorption in a rhythmic or captivating pattern.
categories.exampleScene: Watching embers swirl in a campfire or waves curl over reef rock.

categories.label: Envy
categories.definition: Painful, resentful comparison when someone else receives a coveted recognition or advantage.
categories.exampleScene: Watching a peer receive the fellowship you spent all year applying for.

categories.label: Excitement
categories.definition: Energized, high-arousal anticipation and enthusiasm as a major event begins.
categories.exampleScene: Stepping onto the stage or starting line just as the countdown hits zero.

categories.label: Fear
categories.definition: Urgent defensive alarm in response to an immediate threat to safety.
categories.exampleScene: Hearing tires screech right behind you at a crosswalk.

categories.label: Horror
categories.definition: Shocked, freezing recoil combining intense fear and visceral revulsion.
categories.exampleScene: Witnessing a sudden, catastrophic structural collapse.

categories.label: Interest
categories.definition: Alert curiosity and desire to investigate, learn, or understand more.
categories.exampleScene: Spotting an unexpected clue in a complex problem and leaning in to test it.

categories.label: Joy
categories.definition: Radiant warmth, celebration, and shared happiness.
categories.exampleScene: Reuniting with close friends to celebrate a milestone.

categories.label: Nostalgia
categories.definition: Wistful, bittersweet affection for a cherished time or place that has passed.
categories.exampleScene: Finding a box of handwritten letters and photos from childhood summers.

categories.label: Attraction (Romance)
categories.definition: Tender romantic attraction and emotional closeness (grouped under Attraction).
categories.exampleScene: Walking together through quiet city streets after an unforgettable conversation.

categories.label: Sadness
categories.definition: Sorrow and heavy withdrawal following loss or disappointment.
categories.exampleScene: Saying goodbye at the terminal before a loved one moves overseas.

categories.label: Satisfaction
categories.definition: Deep contentment after completing a meaningful craft or resolving a challenge.
categories.exampleScene: Stepping back to admire a finished workshop build at the end of the day.

categories.label: Attraction (Desire)
categories.definition: Passionate magnetic attraction (grouped with Romance under the unified Attraction category).
categories.exampleScene: Shared lingering eye contact and magnetic closeness across a room.

categories.label: Surprise
categories.definition: Split-second orienting reflex when reality violates immediate expectations.
categories.exampleScene: Opening the front door to find friends gathered for an unannounced birthday celebration.

categories.label: Sympathy
categories.definition: Caring sorrow and supportive concern for someone experiencing hardship.
categories.exampleScene: Listening attentively as a friend talks through a difficult family loss.

categories.label: Triumph
categories.definition: Victorious surge of energy and mastery after overcoming a formidable obstacle.
categories.exampleScene: Crossing the finish line or solving a problem the whole team thought was impossible.

socialAndSelfConsciousItems.headPose: Head pitch -10 deg, yaw +8 deg, gaze down
socialAndSelfConsciousItems.cues: Gaze shifts downward, head tilts down and slightly away, controlled sheepish smile (AU12+24), hand-to-face/neck gesture.
socialAndSelfConsciousItems.explanation: Embarrassment combines downward gaze aversion, a controlled smile (AU12+24), slight head turn, and a self-touch gesture — unlike shame, which lacks the smile and collapses posture.

socialAndSelfConsciousItems.cues: Deep downward head drop (-20 deg), averted downward gaze, collapsed/slumped shoulders, sad lower face (AU15+17) with no smile.
socialAndSelfConsciousItems.explanation: Shame drops the head deeply (-20 deg) and collapses the upper body without the sheepish smile of embarrassment.

socialAndSelfConsciousItems.headPose: Head pitch +10 deg (chin up), direct gaze
socialAndSelfConsciousItems.cues: Chin tilted up (+10 deg), expanded chest and open shoulders, small composed smile (AU12 at 0.35).
socialAndSelfConsciousItems.explanation: Pride elevates the chin (+10 deg), expands chest posture, and displays a small, composed symmetric smile.

socialAndSelfConsciousItems.cues: Brows lowered (AU4), cheeks raised (AU6), eyelids tightly squeezed (AU7), nose wrinkled (AU9), lips parted in a wince (AU25).
socialAndSelfConsciousItems.explanation: Pain combines strong brow lowering (AU4) with intense orbital squeezing (AU6+7) and nose wrinkling (AU9).

socialAndSelfConsciousItems.headPose: Head pitch -2 deg, steady forward gaze
socialAndSelfConsciousItems.cues: Brows knitted (AU4) and eyelids slightly narrowed (AU7) while the mouth and jaw stay completely relaxed; leaning forward.
socialAndSelfConsciousItems.explanation: Concentration knits the brows (AU4+7) like anger, but lacks lip pressing (AU23/24) or glare (AU5) and pairs with calm, focused posture.

socialAndSelfConsciousItems.headPose: Head pitch +2 deg, yaw -5 deg, roll +3 deg
socialAndSelfConsciousItems.cues: One outer eyebrow raised (unilateral AU2) paired with a raised, pushed-up chin boss (AU17) and evaluating head tilt.
socialAndSelfConsciousItems.explanation: Skepticism combines a unilateral outer brow raise (AU2) with a chin raise (AU17) and slight head tilt.

socialAndSelfConsciousItems.headPose: Head roll +8 deg, brow furrow AU4 + unilateral AU1
socialAndSelfConsciousItems.cues: Head tilted to one side, brows drawn together (AU4) with slight squint (AU7) as the listener tries to reconcile conflicting information.
socialAndSelfConsciousItems.explanation: Confusion pairs brow knitting (AU4+7) with a questioning lateral head tilt.

socialAndSelfConsciousItems.headPose: Head pitch -5 deg, roll +6 deg, heavy lids
socialAndSelfConsciousItems.cues: Drooping upper eyelids, slack facial tone, head resting or tilted lazily with slumped posture.
socialAndSelfConsciousItems.explanation: Boredom shows low arousal, slack facial muscles, drooping eyelids, and slumped body posture.

socialAndSelfConsciousItems.headPose: Head pitch +2 deg, slight inner/outer brow lift, leaning in
socialAndSelfConsciousItems.cues: Forward lean, steady attentive gaze, slight brow elevation (trace AU1+2) opening the eyes without surprise jaw drop.
socialAndSelfConsciousItems.explanation: Interest is signaled by forward torso lean, direct gaze, and gentle upper-face alertness.

socialAndSelfConsciousItems.headPose: Head pitch +3 deg then settling, soft eyelids, parted lips
socialAndSelfConsciousItems.cues: Shoulders dropping in an exhale, eyebrows relaxing from tension into a soft smile (low AU6+12) with slightly parted lips (AU25).
socialAndSelfConsciousItems.explanation: Relief releases muscular tension with dropping shoulders, softening eyelids, and a gentle exhale smile.

socialAndSelfConsciousItems.headPose: Head pitch -12 deg, oblique brows AU1+4, restless gaze
socialAndSelfConsciousItems.cues: Oblique inner brows (AU1+4) and downward gaze focused on repairing a specific harm rather than total body collapse.
socialAndSelfConsciousItems.explanation: Guilt combines sad concern (AU1+4) and downward gaze with action-oriented tension.

socialAndSelfConsciousItems.headPose: Head roll +5 deg, soft oblique brows AU1 + gentle warm AU12
socialAndSelfConsciousItems.cues: Forward-leaning posture, gentle head tilt, concerned inner brows (AU1) paired with a reassuring, soft mouth (low AU12).
socialAndSelfConsciousItems.explanation: Compassion blends concerned inner brows (AU1) with warm, reassuring openness (low AU12) and a supportive forward lean.
